newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul bourse to put Sammi shrs on supervision list.
newsitem.headline: Seoul bourse to put Sammi shrs on supervision list.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would put shares of Sammi Steel Co and Sammi Corp on its supervision list from Thursday.
An exchange statement said the decision came after Sammi Steel and Sammi Corp applied for court receivership.
While under supervision, settlements for the two companies' shares will be matched only two times a day, in the morning and afternoon sessions.
The exchange suspended trading of Sammi Steel and Sammi Corp shares on Wednesday morning at 3,220 won and 1,620 won respectively.
They will resume trading on Saturday.
